description:
The French Country 4 Drawer Dresser offers a perfect blend of storage capacity and nursery functionality. Four spacious dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides provide room for clothing, bedding, and essentials, while the flat top accommodates a changing pad for a complete diaper station.

Crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing including turned legs and decorative hardware, this dresser brings timeless charm to any nursery. The warm finishes highlight the natural beauty of the wood grain, creating a piece that feels both rustic and refined. From newborn layettes to toddler clothes, the generous drawer space keeps everything organized and accessible.

Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
